column1: # The proofs of the gates of block B6 (plan 2026-11-26-fase2-b6-tray-chiusura.md, «Dove gira ogni gate in CI»): G10, the tray and the
# closing of the window; G11, the check for a newer version. Same format as gates-b5.tsv, and `scripts/check-gates.py` reads both: a gate
# gate <TAB> job <TAB> kind <TAB> name of the proof. `scripts/check-gates.py --job <job>` runs at the end of the job that declares the
# gate and fails if a proof listed here for that job is missing from the output, skipped, ignored or red. A task that adds a proof adds
# its row in the same commit; tests/config.rs (`every_gate_has_a_job`, `every_proof_of_the_manifests_is_a_test_that_exists`) keeps the
# jobs of these files and the ones of ci.yml together, and the names with the tests.
# G10, the menu of the tray read and clicked from the session bus, the window hidden and the session left alone: the job `gui-smoke`
# (ui/e2e/tray.e2e.ts, the app built as for a release, under Xvfb, with the probe of lab/tests/tray-probe.py as the desktop that shows it).
# G10, the real tunnel of the real daemon, on the three clients: the window connects, is closed, and for ten seconds the tunnel stays up
# (ui/e2e/lab-connect.e2e.ts); the client saw `glr-wg0` in every sample between the marks the window wrote (t18).
# G11, the check for a newer version: one request, no identifier, none when it is off, at most one a day, no redirect followed. Counted by a
# server that is not GitHub: in Rust (`cargo test -p galleria-gui`, job `gui`) and with the app built as for a release (job `gui-smoke`).
